sub_graphs.title: EIP-5593: Secure Context Provider Injection
sub_graphs.description: Models the security boundary for Ethereum provider API injection into web contexts

nodes.label: Web Page Load Initiated
nodes.description: Browser begins loading a web page that may request Ethereum provider

nodes.label: Check Secure Context Status
nodes.description: Wallet checks if window.isSecureContext returns true

nodes.label: Context is Secure
nodes.description: Page is loaded over HTTPS or is HTTP localhost

nodes.label: Context is Insecure
nodes.description: Page is loaded over HTTP (non-localhost) or other insecure origin

nodes.label: Check Potentially Trustworthy Origin
nodes.description: Verify origin meets W3C Secure Contexts trustworthiness criteria

nodes.label: Origin is Trustworthy
nodes.description: Origin passes all trustworthiness checks

nodes.label: Origin is Untrustworthy
nodes.description: Origin fails trustworthiness verification

nodes.label: Inject window.ethereum Provider
nodes.description: Wallet injects the Ethereum provider API into the page context

nodes.label: Provider Available
nodes.description: window.ethereum is defined and accessible to the page

nodes.label: Provider Blocked
nodes.description: window.ethereum is undefined due to security restrictions

sub_graphs.title: EIP-5593: Iframe Provider Access Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation rules for provider access in iframe contexts

nodes.label: Iframe Context Detected
nodes.description: Code is executing within an iframe, not top-level window

nodes.label: Check First vs Third Party
nodes.description: Determine if iframe origin matches parent page origin

nodes.label: First-Party Iframe
nodes.description: Iframe origin matches parent page origin (same-origin)

nodes.label: Third-Party Iframe
nodes.description: Iframe origin differs from parent page origin (cross-origin)

nodes.label: Check Sandbox Attribute
nodes.description: Verify sandbox attribute allows same-origin or is absent

nodes.label: Sandbox Configuration Compatible
nodes.description: No sandbox attribute or sandbox='allow-same-origin' present

nodes.label: Sandbox Too Restrictive
nodes.description: Sandbox attribute blocks provider access

nodes.label: Check Permissions API
nodes.description: Check if third-party iframe has explicit provider permission

nodes.label: Third-Party Permission Granted
nodes.description: Explicit permission granted via Permissions API

nodes.label: Third-Party Permission Denied
nodes.description: No permission for third-party provider access

nodes.label: Iframe Provider Access Allowed
nodes.description: Iframe passes all checks, provider will be injected

nodes.label: Iframe Provider Access Blocked
nodes.description: Iframe fails checks, window.ethereum will be undefined

external_entities.description: Potentially malicious ad iframe attempting to access wallet

sub_graphs.title: EIP-5593: Developer Mode Exception
sub_graphs.description: Models the developer mode toggle that allows localhost HTTP access

nodes.label: HTTP Localhost Detected
nodes.description: Page is served from http://localhost or http://127.0.0.1

nodes.label: Check Developer Mode Setting
nodes.description: Check if wallet's developer mode toggle is enabled

nodes.label: Developer Mode Enabled
nodes.description: User has explicitly enabled developer mode in wallet settings

nodes.label: Developer Mode Disabled
nodes.description: Developer mode is disabled (default state)

nodes.label: Localhost Provider Allowed
nodes.description: HTTP localhost granted provider access via dev mode

nodes.label: Localhost Provider Blocked
nodes.description: HTTP localhost denied provider access

external_entities.name: DApp Developer
external_entities.description: Developer running local development server for testing

ambiguities.text: The specification says third-party iframes 'should be blocked by default' but implementations 'may allow access via Permissions API'
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume 'should' means RECOMMENDED but not REQUIRED. Wallets MUST block third-party iframes by default but MAY implement Permissions API as an opt-in mechanism.

ambiguities.text: The specification does not define behavior when a first-party iframe has both sandbox and allow-same-origin attributes with other restrictions
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume if allow-same-origin is present, the provider can be injected regardless of other sandbox restrictions like allow-scripts.

ambiguities.text: The term 'potentially trustworthy origin' references W3C spec but does not enumerate all qualifying origins
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume W3C Secure Contexts definition applies: HTTPS, localhost HTTP, file://, and user-configured trustworthy origins.

implicit_assumptions.description: The browser correctly implements and reports window.isSecureContext
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A compromised or buggy browser could report insecure contexts as secure, bypassing wallet security checks

implicit_assumptions.description: HTTPS origins have a valid certificate chain to a trusted root CA
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Man-in-the-middle attacks could present fraudulent pages that appear secure, gaining provider access

implicit_assumptions.description: Attackers cannot compromise the user's localhost development environment
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If dev mode is enabled and localhost is compromised, attacker gains full provider access

implicit_assumptions.description: Users understand the security implications of enabling developer mode
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Users might enable dev mode permanently, expanding the attack surface beyond development scenarios
